name: Bunkroom

hatch_berth.name: Berth Hatch
hatch_berth.description: Oval pressure seal leading to the primary transfer platform.

spigot_01.name: Water Tap
spigot_01.description: Push-valve tap metering gray-line recycled potable water.

personal_locker.name: Crew Locker
personal_locker.description: Metal footlocker tucked under a cot. Contains discarded shift notes and copper wire.

vent_duct.name: Vent Crawlway
vent_duct.description: Narrow maintenance duct descending behind conduit lines straight to the sub-deck.

crew_bunk.name: Crew Bunk
crew_bunk.description: Fold-down bunk with a thin mattress. Sleep here to start a new day.

description: Narrow sleeping bay lined with fold-down bunks. Recycled air smells faintly of cleaning solvent.

name: Berth 04

hatch_bunks.name: Bunkroom Hatch
hatch_bunks.description: Hatch back to the shared sleeping quarters.

cargo_hoist.name: Cargo Hoist
cargo_hoist.description: Chain-driven freight platform descending into the sub-deck conduit well.

shuttle_gate.name: Shuttle Gate
shuttle_gate.description: Flexible boarding seal clamped to the shuttle. Takes one transit token per boarding, then reseals.

freight_skid.name: Freight Skid
freight_skid.description: Heavy industrial pallet lashed down with tension clamps. Loose packing holds spare salvage.

salvage_bin.name: Scrap Bin
salvage_bin.description: Welded steel bin holding discarded copper pipe fittings and scrap brackets.

hab_hatch.name: Hab Ring Hatch
hab_hatch.description: Wide corridor hatch leading up to the hab ring common gallery.

umbilical_collar.name: Docking Collar
umbilical_collar.description: Access panel for the shuttle docking collar. Re-seating the collar by hand fools the gate into cycling open once.

freight_clamps.name: Cargo Clamps
freight_clamps.description: Ratchet clamps holding a freight skid bound for the shuttle hold. Released, there is room to ride along unseen.

npc_kael.name: Kael
npc_kael.title: Dock Stevedore
npc_kael.status: Checking tension clamps on freight skid
npc_kael.dialogue_idle: Shuttle to the Moon is warming up. If you've got spare pipe collars or salvage, I can endorse a work pass for the freight deck.
npc_kael.dialogue_post_trade: Collar's seated. Pass endorsed. Take care on the sub-deck; Radek's down there cursing at a frozen valve.
dialogue_variants: You lash skids like a Berth hand. Bring me a pipe collar and I'll stamp you a pass; the hoist knows your kind of shoulders anyway.

description: Open transfer bay smelling of hydraulic fluid and ozone. Cargo skids line the deck under industrial lighting.

name: Sub-Deck

hoist_up.name: Hoist Up
hoist_up.description: Chain platform ascending back to Berth 04.

vent_to_bunk.name: Vent Up
vent_to_bunk.description: Climbing rungs inside the ventilation riser back to the bunkroom.

jammed_valve.name: Frozen Valve
jammed_valve.description: Thermal bypass valve seized shut by line ice. Freeing it restores pressure and heat to the conduits.

tool_rack.name: Tool Rack
tool_rack.description: Industrial tool board mounted on the conduit wall. Holds a thermal pry-bar.

npc_radek.name: Radek
npc_radek.title: Cargo Rigger
npc_radek.dialogue_idle: Valve's iced solid. Can't get the air back without a pry-bar. Got one? I've got an extra shuttle token if you help crack it.
npc_radek.dialogue_post_trade: Valve's turning. Heat's coming back. I'm ready to roll if you need a hand hauling freight.
dialogue_variants: Another lifter. Good. Crack this valve with me and I'll ride along wherever you're hauling.

description: Low-ceilinged conduit passage. Frost crusts the pipe manifolds. The air is thin and bites cold.

name: Hab Ring

hatch_to_berth.name: Berth Hatch
hatch_to_berth.description: Wide corridor hatch leading down to the transfer berths.

notice_board.name: Notice Board
notice_board.description: Postings: shift rosters, fuel quotas on Station Beta, and reports of seismic tremors in the lunar mines.
notice_board.log_text: Shift roster: Berth 04 hoist crew short two riggers. Fuel quota on Station Beta raised 8%. Lunar mine reports tremors on the lower gallery.
notice_board.log_text_locked: Maintenance memo, scratched over: 'Shuttle docking collar can be re-seated by hand with a spanner or a pipe collar. The gate trusts the collar.'

algae_basin.name: Algae Vat
algae_basin.description: Green spirulina culture bubbling behind acrylic. Can yield fresh nutrient paste.

npc_mira.name: Mira
npc_mira.title: Hab Botanist
npc_mira.status: Checking nutrient flow in algae basin
npc_mira.dialogue_idle: Recycler pumps are surging. If you have clean wire or copper fittings to ground this sensor, I can spare a clean canteen.
npc_mira.dialogue_post_trade: Sensor's grounded. Water's running sweet. If you're heading out to the outer rings, I can monitor your bio-filters.
dialogue_variants: You've rinsed filters before, I can tell. Ground this sensor with wire or copper and I'll trade you a canteen.

description: Curved corridor segment with brushed-metal walls. Handrails run at waist height. Faint hum of air recyclers.

name: Shuttle

gate_alpha.name: Door to Station A
gate_alpha.description: Docking collar sealed to Station Alpha's Berth 04.

gate_beta.name: Door to Station B
gate_beta.description: Docking collar clamped to Station Beta's Dock Ring.

gate_luna.name: Door to Moon
gate_luna.description: Reinforced exterior airlock leading directly down to the lunar surface apron.

flight_console.name: Flight Screen
flight_console.description: Automated guidance screen displaying orbital ephemeris, lunar pad coordinates, and radiation forecasts.
flight_console.log_text: Ephemeris: lunar pad window open. Surface forecast 25 mSv, -80 C. Pad-to-dome airlock is 3 tiles south of the lander hatch. Do not linger.
flight_console.log_text_locked: Cargo manifest, restricted: freight skids at Berth 04 ride the shuttle hold unsealed. Clamp tension is the only check.

description: Functional shuttle shuttle cabin with four acceleration couches. Reinforced viewports overlook the lunar rim.

name: Dock Ring

shuttle_return.name: Shuttle Door
shuttle_return.description: Umbilical back to the inter-station shuttle shuttle.

hatch_array.name: Comms Hub Hatch
hatch_array.description: Pressure hatch leading to the communications array center.

hatch_fuel.name: Fuel Spur Hatch
hatch_fuel.description: Blast door to the fuel processing and propellant manifold.

freight_crate.name: Cargo Crate
freight_crate.description: Steel shipping crate bound with nylon bands. Can be levered open with a pry-bar.

npc_tarek.name: Tarek
npc_tarek.title: Array Specialist
npc_tarek.status: Monitoring signal telemetry on hand slate
npc_tarek.dialogue_idle: Comms array on Beta is picking up anomalous seismic echoes from the lunar crater. Got steel dice or trade tokens? I have copper wire coils.
npc_tarek.dialogue_post_trade: Deal. If you ever need remote terminals bypassed or signals boosted, signal me.
dialogue_variants: You read the array bursts too? Then you know the tube is leaking. Trade tokens still buy my wire and my time.

description: Wide docking bay with magnetic clamp rails. The air smells of fuel volatiles and industrial lubricant.

name: Comms Hub

hatch_dock.name: Dock Hatch
hatch_dock.description: Corridor hatch leading back to Dock Ring Bay 7.

comms_rack.name: Radio Rack
comms_rack.description: Signal array intercepting transmissions across the orbit. Mentions high-grade ore found in the Lunar Lava Tube.
comms_rack.log_text: Intercepts across the orbit. Routine traffic between Beta dock and the lunar dome.
comms_rack.log_text_locked: Decoded burst from a surveyor beacon: breach in the lava tube wall, east of the ladder. Elastomer patch would hold it. Tube pressure recovers if sealed.

crypto_terminal.name: Relay Terminal
crypto_terminal.description: Encrypted relay terminal with exposed wiring. Bridging its relay with electrical wire prints a forged shift clearance.

description: Hexagonal chamber packed with computing racks. Green status LEDs blink in rhythmic patterns.

name: Fuel Spur

hatch_dock_fuel.name: Dock Hatch
hatch_dock_fuel.description: Blast door back to Dock Ring.

fuel_manifold.name: Fuel Gauges
fuel_manifold.description: High-pressure fuel injection lines running floor to ceiling.
fuel_manifold.log_text: Line pressures nominal. Placard: propellant crews eat on shift; bring your own rations.
fuel_manifold.log_text_locked: Refinery ledger: Kovac trades patches for food. Vance on the smelter floor pays in tools for raw ore.

spares_cabinet.name: Spares Cabinet
spares_cabinet.description: Steel wall cabinet storing silicone seal patches.

npc_kovac.name: Kovac
npc_kovac.title: Refinery Tech
npc_kovac.status: Checking pressure gauges on propellant lines
npc_kovac.dialogue_idle: Shift's gone four hours past relief. Got a ration block? I can trade seal patches.
npc_kovac.dialogue_post_trade: Much obliged. These patches will hold against pure vacuum if you blow a seal down on the pad.
dialogue_variants: Is that Mira? Tell her the fuel spur air is fine. Rations still buy patches.

description: Processing bay filled with heavy fuel lines and hazard placards. Smell of solvent hangs in the air.

name: Landing Pad

lander_hatch.name: Shuttle Hatch
lander_hatch.description: Ascent module hatch back to the shuttle shuttle.

dome_airlock.name: Dome Airlock
dome_airlock.description: Reinforced airlock cylinder leading into the pressurized habitat dome.

regolith_sled.name: Old Survey Sled
regolith_sled.description: Unmanned lunar utility sled abandoned on the regolith. Contains basalt scrap.

description: Flat regolith landing apron under unfiltered stars. Gray dust covers the deck. Total vacuum silence.

name: Habitat Dome

airlock_pad.name: Pad Airlock
airlock_pad.description: Airlock back to the exposed lunar surface pad.

hatch_smelter.name: Smelter Hatch
hatch_smelter.description: Reinforced hatch leading to the smelting floor.

hatch_crater.name: Crater Hatch
hatch_crater.description: Exterior airlock leading out to the crater observation rim.

seismic_station.name: Quake Monitor
seismic_station.description: Readouts confirm cavernous basalt structures beneath the crater floor.
seismic_station.log_text: Readouts confirm cavernous basalt structures beneath the crater floor.
seismic_station.log_text_locked: Seismic survey note: the mine cage takes two operators or one trained lifter. Mine air is thin and hot with radiation. Budget your exposure.

dome_locker.name: Dome Locker
dome_locker.description: Shared crew locker by the airlock. Someone left a ration behind.

seed_crate.name: Seed Crate
seed_crate.description: Cold-packed crate of starter cultures for the trays.

dome_board.name: Dome Board
dome_board.log_text: Dome roster: surface walks in pairs. Pad-to-airlock is the shortest run on this moon.
dome_board.log_text_locked: Maintenance note: the lava tube breach vents into the crater. Seal it and the tube holds air.
dome_board.description: Wall screen with crew rosters and surface forecasts.

hydro_tray.name: Hydroponic Tray
hydro_tray.description: Shallow tray of algae under daylight panels. Filter work needs a trained hand or a spanner.

dome_tap.name: Dome Water Tap
dome_tap.description: Recycled water tap. Fills any canteen.

dome_bunk.name: Dome Bunk
dome_bunk.description: Spare bunk behind a privacy curtain. Sleep here to start a new day.

npc_chen.name: Olena Chen
npc_chen.title: Field Geologist
npc_chen.status: Analyzing core samples from deep mine
npc_chen.dialogue_idle: The volcanic tube below the crater is rich with ancient minerals. Bring me scrap from the surface sled and I will trade specialized tools.
npc_chen.dialogue_post_trade: Excellent material. If you descend into the crater or lava tube, watch your pressure gauge; the cold contracts valve seals rapidly.
dialogue_variants: You've been in the tube. Did you see the east wall? That seam is venting. Scrap buys you a spanner.

description: Geodesic dome with hydroponic trays and artificial daylight panels. Safe haven from vacuum.

name: Smelter

hatch_dome_smelter.name: Dome Hatch
hatch_dome_smelter.description: Corridor back to the habitat dome.

mine_shaft.name: Mine Lift
mine_shaft.description: Heavy industrial lift descending into the deep mining shaft. Requires two operators.

smelting_crucible.name: Crucible
smelting_crucible.description: Induction furnace capable of refining raw basalt ore into structural fittings and tools.

npc_vance.name: Vance
npc_vance.title: Smelter Veteran
npc_vance.dialogue_idle: Deep mine has plenty of raw basalt ore, but the lift needs nerve to ride. Bring me an ore sample and I'll forge you a heavy pry-bar.
npc_vance.dialogue_post_trade: Clean melt. Here's your iron bar. Treat it right and it'll crack open any sealed hatch on this moon.
dialogue_variants: You rode the cage and came back. Hand me a core of that ore and I'll forge you a bar.

description: Industrial floor vibrating with furnace hum. Fine ore dust settles on every surface. Dry heat.

name: Crater Rim

hatch_dome_crater.name: Dome Hatch
hatch_dome_crater.description: Airlock back to the pressurized habitat dome.

tube_entrance.name: Ladder Down
tube_entrance.description: Ladder and winch system descending into a vast subsurface volcanic tube.

surveyor_cache.name: Survey Cache
surveyor_cache.description: Pressurized container bolted to the crater rim containing emergency rations.

description: Narrow pathway carved along the rim of an ancient impact crater. Earth hangs silent in the black sky.

name: Deep Mine

cage_up.name: Mine Lift Up
cage_up.description: Cage lift ascending back to Smelter Flat.

ore_face.name: Ore Face
ore_face.description: Dark basalt vein rich in metallic deposits. Yields high-grade lunar ore.

description: Subterranean gallery hacked into basalt rock. Cold creeps from the dark excavation walls.

name: Lava Tube

ascent_ladder.name: Ladder Up
ascent_ladder.description: Steel ladder ascending back up to the crater observation rim.

subsurface_cache.name: Buried Cache
subsurface_cache.description: Canister containing historic tally slates and emergency supplies left by early prospectors.

hull_breach.name: Cracked Wall
hull_breach.description: A crack in the tube wall hissing air out into the crater. An elastomer patch would hold it.

description: Vast natural cavern formed by ancient lava flows. Smooth curved basalt walls vanish into cold darkness.
